article.title: The Trade Desk接入OnAudience，Koa可按簡報建立及啟用受眾
article.title_en: The Trade Desk connects OnAudience audience building and activation to Koa
article.summary: The Trade Desk宣布把OnAudience接入Koa，讓廣告團隊以自然語言尋找及建立受眾。
article.summary_en: The Trade Desk announced an OnAudience integration for finding and building audiences through natural-language requests in Koa.
highlights: 第三方受眾分組可配對活動簡報，並支援直接啟用。
公司表示已在全球提供；速度與準確度未經本刊實測。
highlights_en: Third-party segments can be matched to campaign briefs and activated.
The company says it is globally available; speed and accuracy were not independently tested.
article.why: 簡報與受眾操作接在一起，媒體策劃可先審查系統選了哪些分組，再決定把哪一組帶進投放。
article.why_en: Connected briefing and audience operations let planners inspect selected segments before choosing which to activate.
article.next_step: 用一份現有活動簡報要求Koa提出受眾分組，逐項核對分組定義與目標客群，再批准啟用名單。
article.next_step_en: Ask Koa for segments against an existing brief, compare definitions with the intended audience and approve the activation list.
article.detail: 這次新增的是OnAudience與Koa的連接，不能把原有MCP服務本身當成全新推出。MCP是讓AI工具連接外部資料及功能的協定。對策劃人員而言，重點是把簡報要求逐項對回受眾定義，並保留選擇分組的理由。公告所述操作機制不等於已證明更高轉換率，仍應用實際活動結果評估分組是否合適。
article.detail_en: The new event is the Koa connection, not the creation of OnAudience MCP. MCP links AI tools to external data and functions. Planners should document how segment definitions meet the brief. The workflow does not establish better conversion; evaluate suitability against campaign results.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
